messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "other treatment can be added for gap"
set: ["other treatment can be added for gap", "this mixture can be swallowed", "stopping suddenly can be harmful", "child should be monitored during treatment", "after first use, pen can be stored for 56 days", "eye exam before starting treatment may be recommended for some people", "patients should be periodically reassessed for the appropriate dose of treatment", "pen can be stored in refrigerator", "dose can be adjusted every two weeks for high blood pressure", "treatment will need to be changed carefully", "patients should be periodically reassessed for the continued need of maintenance treatment", "patients should be periodically reassessed to determine the need for maintenance treatment", "later doses can be given by mouth", "IV dose can also be given postoperatively", "can be taken with or without food", "reassessment determines need for ongoing treatment"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
